extended_regex.description: Interpret pattern as extended regular expression (ERE).

fixed_strings.description: Treat pattern and replacement as fixed strings.

all_files.description: Process hidden files (starting with .) in recursive scans.

backup_suffix.description: Backup file suffix (e.g., '.bak'). Implicitly enables backups.

backup_control.description: Backup version control method: none, numbered, existing, simple.

keep_times.description: Restore original file timestamps after processing.

pattern.description: The search pattern (regex or fixed string).

include_patterns.description: List of file name glob patterns to include.

exclude_patterns.description: List of file name glob patterns to exclude.

exclude_dirs.description: List of directory name patterns to exclude during recursion.

target_files.description: List of files or directories to process.
